scope: Review two TikHub and five SimilarWeb response gaps. Retain the source-backed TikHub Excel declaration; leave TikHub trending and all five SimilarWeb success responses explicitly unreviewed.
method: Compare the enabled runtime operation with the pinned provider source and public response binding.
Probe quote then run through the AIsa gateway using a local key; record only status and response shape.
Publish only fields declared by the provider source or observed in the response envelope.
